Leah Morgan: Customer Q requests 7y audit evidence searchable. Need a minimal, contractable approach that won’t bankrupt ops.
Marco Rivera: Suggest tiered model: fast-search 12mo, archived blobs + manifest beyond that, reindex-on-demand for extended period (48-72h SLA).
Tanya Singh: Legal needs signed manifest (hash alg + UTC timestamps), access audit trail, and BYOK compatibility for archives.
Marco Rivera: Implementation proposal: store chunks at audits/tenant=<id>/archive/YYYY/MM/chunk-<uuid>.ndjson.gz; companion manifest.json.sig with sha256 entries and created_at UTC. Metadata header x-archive-policy: extended.
Leah Morgan: MVP acceptance bullets: 1) contract addendum template for extended retention and reindex billing 2) archive pipeline that emits signed manifests + checksums 3) BYOK encryption for archives 4) retrieval runbook + 72h SLA for pilot 5) audit logs for retrieval and manifest verification.
LegalBot: Note: require customer acknowledgement of escrow option if they rotate/revoke BYOK; limit offering to enterprise contract customers initially.
ops-bot: RFC created RFC-ER-170500. Link PRs to RFC.
Tanya Singh: Action items: Marco prototype manifest + BYOK flow; Leah draft addendum; Ops to estimate cost. Follow-up Wednesday 10am PT.
